title: Vertical wired glass.
officialText: Wired glass sloped 15 degrees (0.26 rad) or less from vertical in windows, curtain and window walls, doors and other exterior applications shall be designed to resist the wind loads in Section 1609 for components and cladding according to the following equation: F < 0.5 F (Equation 24-6) gw ge where: F = Is the wind load on the glass computed per Section 1609. gw F = Nonfactored load from ASTM E 1300 using a thickness designation for monolithic glass that is not greater than the thickness of ge wired glass.
